note: Curated sign-up keys. DATA only: every address, host, header name and test address here was written by a person and checked against the service's own page on the date above. The model never adds or changes a row. A row may only use header placement in this version; query placement is refused by security/keys.py.

keys.name: Brave Search
keys.for: Searching the whole web when you ask me to.
signup_steps: Sign up with your email address.
Pick the free plan. Brave asks for a payment card to stop abuse. It does not charge while you stay under the free amount, and this bot stops at 900 searches a month so you stay under it.
Make a key on the API keys page and copy it.
keys.cost_note: Free up to about 1,000 searches a month. Brave asks for a payment card when you sign up.
keys.results_note: Brave's terms do not let this bot keep search results, so saved chats keep a short note instead of the answer.

keys.name: Marginalia Search
keys.for: Searching the web when you ask me to, with no payment card. Its list of websites is small, so answers can be thin.
signup_steps: That page gives an email address. Send it a short note asking for a free key for personal use.
The key comes back by email. Copy it.
keys.how_long: one email, then a wait for the reply
keys.cost_note: Free for personal use only. No payment card.
keys.results_note: Marginalia's results are shared for non-commercial use only.

keys.name: GitHub
keys.for: Searching GitHub with your own account, and finding your own projects and the ones you starred.
signup_steps: Sign in to GitHub. A free account is enough.
On the new token page, name the token BuildBot and pick when it runs out.
Choose Public repositories to let BuildBot search and see your public projects. To let it use a private project too, pick that project and set Contents to Read-only.
Press Generate token and copy it.
keys.privacy_note: While your GitHub account is connected, GitHub can link these searches to your account.

keys.name: Anthropic
keys.for: Toolsmith's cloud model, when you choose it in Settings: it installs and starts apps.
keys.cost_note: Anthropic bills your account for each use. Settings shows about how much Toolsmith used. This bot stops at 3000 requests a month.
signup_steps: Sign in to the Anthropic Console.
Add a payment method under Billing.
Make a key on the API keys page and copy it.
